title.zh: DSH 插件索引 · 观察池

description.en: Passed every hard gate but scored low or carries unresolved soft warnings.
description.zh: 通过全部硬门，但分数偏低或带有未解决的软风险。

description.en: Automatic provider/model fallback chains for DeepSeek Harness agents when LLM requests keep failing (retry exhausted, auth, quota, rate limit)
Hard gate for self-modification restarts: a green-build credential bound to the git HEAD, checked before any restart of the running instance

Capability catalog: enumerate every skill and tool in the running instance with its registration channel (official builtin, project, user, custom, plugin runtime). A standalone settings tab (工具与技能) lists skills as a three-column preview grid — click for a modal with full detail, SKILL.md source, me…
User-message edit (withdraw and resend) and withdrawal: the withdrawal writes a surface replacement that hides the message and everything after it from the model, with a chat divider marking the spot

Session products preview, host+client in one: the read-only file-preview Remote service (the files a session wrote or edited, current content, per-change diffs) plus the right-sidebar 会话产物 tab, per-turn change cards, and the file detail view
Local code-agent harness registry and glue: scoped homes, /<harness> login and sessions commands, delegation provider contracts, and the roster-driven browser settings section

Codex harness for dsh-local-agent: scoped CODEX_HOME, one-shot codex exec delegation visible in the 子代理 surface, rollout-file session records; the session-granted `subagent_codex` delegation tool ships as the package's `./tool` composition entry

dsh harness for dsh-local-agent: delegate to dsh itself as a local CLI — scoped DSH_HOME under the shared homes root, one-shot sub-dsh runs visible in the 子代理 surface, caller-supplied session ids, resume across rounds, DeepSeek toggle in settings

TaskPilot — dock pills above the composer for background jobs and subagents, with stop/interrupt verbs, live duration and token readouts, and a job detail right-sidebar tab. A zero-intrusion community bundle for DeepSeek Harness.
DSH用户级配置同步插件，更新需重启DSH
深鲸记忆：跨会话热记忆（每轮注入 MEMORY/USER + memory 工具读写）+ 记忆体检、瘦身归档、记忆包、诊断报告、文档只读。本地明文、零依赖、不上传数据。
Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 + 原生视觉模型接入（deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 直读截图），screen_observe 等 20 个模型友好工具；浏览器组 browser_* 为兜底
Create Blender product scenes in DSH with editable recipes, model imports, previews and PNG/MP4 delivery; includes workbench and agent configuration.
为 DeepSeek Harness 提供独立的图像生成与编辑 Skill、工具和设置界面。
DSH Archive Manager - preview, restore, and delete archived sessions from the settings page
RDB durable session backend for DeepSeek Harness: implements both session-persistence and session-branch (rewind / retry / fork) providers.
Rewind / retry / recall / fork orchestration (host) plus the browser half — replaces the conversation.chat.node user / steering rendering and overrides the conversation.composer.dock stats row.

DSH plugin: one shell tool that runs commands through PowerShell, Git Bash, MSYS2, or WSL on Windows, plus an embedded terminal for the bottom dock (dsh-better-sidebar's terminal tab) with per-shell activation switches and a default-shell fallback chain.

DSH web plugin (dsh-better-sidebar consumer): render the session brief — the todo list (the `todos` projection board) plus the artifact list (a live produced-files feed, codeplan artifacts marked) — as a summary tab in the right sidebar, and shadow the official composer-band todo panel so the board…

Patch-style file editing for DeepSeek Harness: one apply_patch tool accepting git/unified diff (default) and Codex apply_patch syntax (opt-in), with all-or-nothing application, read-before-write intent dance, sandbox-aware delete/move,  (declarative volatile settings).

DSH permission-gate for the DeepSeek Harness 0.1.5 line: a single self-sufficient, deterministic-first, fail-closed gate covering P0 hard-deny -> P1 session grant -> P2 static rule (allow/deny) chain -> P3 optional LLM semantic classifier -> P4 ask, with command whitelist/blacklist.

Local tool-call failsafe for DSH: blocks a fixed list of high-risk shell patterns and credential-file reads before execution, with a per-session hash-linked JSONL audit log, and an optional external Gateway for centralized policy.
L0~L3 分层蒸馏记忆插件 for DeepSeek Harness：自动捕获对话（L0）、抽取原子记忆（L1）、整合场景块（L2）、蒸馏核心画像/团队方法论（L3），并在模型步骤前自动召回注入。移植自 MemoryCore (TencentDB Agent Memory) 的管线设计。
高峰自动会话门：周末模式 + 高峰自动暂停 + 官方源二维判定 + 会话级冻结 + 后端自动重试。
DSH Web 插件：会话管家（合并包）—— 会话历史文件（归档浏览与清理）与健康检查（体检 → 处方 → 出院），外加独立 FTS5 会话内容搜索索引（标题/内容双模式、增量同步、非破坏性整理与快照导入导出）。不碰会话日志、只做可逆处置。
GLM (Zhipu bigmodel) web search provider for DeepSeek Harness: native web_search via the Anthropic-compatible Messages API, with GLM response-format translation.
连接小沐（MuChe 数字生命）的 dsh 插件：可以和有持续状态的小沐聊天，小沐可调用本机 dsh 执行任务
Aident CLI — umbrella access to Loadout integrations, Playbook automation, Intern tools, and the Aident platform.

ego-browser (ego-lite) integration plugin for DSH: structured browser-automation tools (34 ego_*) that drive the vendored ego runtime through ctx.subprocess, plus a realtime watch panel (live SSE screencast + direct mouse interaction + download capture + human-verification notice). Web shell: nativ…
DSH client plugin for dsh-mesh: turns a signed, content-free wake ping from the hub into a real session turn, with a settings page, inbox card and history cache.
DSH web plugin: token 用量统计看板 + 单会话（主智能体 + 子智能体）用量统计。提供今日/近3天/近7天/近1月/近3月/自定义筛选、六个汇总卡片、活跃热力图、缓存命中率折线与分模型柱状图、按模型/按供应商 Top5 列表。

Thinking-loop guard for dsh: observes the llm/stream waterfall and breaks a model that degrades into a loop. Detects three per-call shapes (reasoning-only calls, restated-material calls, self-repeating low-entropy reasoning) and re-fires instead of latching; plus three mid-stream breakers that end …

Browse the DeepSeek Harness skill catalog from the Web UI: a top-right header button and a 查看技能 item in the Workspace folder dropdowns open a right-side drawer with each skill's trigger conditions and description.
DSH Market 插件端：cordis 侧边栏插件（浏览/搜索/猜你喜欢/一键安装/已装管理），核心逻辑来自 @dsh-market/core

TypeSafe (System One / Jev) decision primitives as a host service: typed noul/choice/score judgements through one named-question registry, with credential-reference key resolution, bounded timeout, retry, circuit breaker, cache and decision logs. Other plugins call it in code; the model-facing type…
Microi吾码 AI 开发 CLI 与多宿主 Plugin：服务器连接、Skills、MCP、V8 同步和低代码交付
DingTalk Stream text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Feishu and Lark text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
QQ Bot channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
WeCom AI Bot text, image, and file channel bridge for DeepSeek Harness
Official Weixin iLink text, image, and file bridge for DeepSeek Harness
AgentOne 平台集成：平台模型、SkillHub 技能、套餐、CLI、飞书云盘共享文件夹（web/官方桌面端侧栏页签 + 左栏底部入口）、左栏「工作台」面板；插件装前宿主兼容预检；官方桌面端「关于」页自升级修复：分离进程 pnpm 通道绕开宿主 already-installed 死路（Windows 适配），附「让 AI 代升级」一句话引导
Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DeepSeek Harness — stream Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions into DSH with thinking, tool activity, token usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.

AI Book Shelf: read EPUB, PDF, TXT, Markdown, HTML, FB2 and DOCX; select text for one-click background and explanations, then follow up without leaving the page; full-book search, online book search and custom sources; paper mode with translation, bilingual compare, explanations and follow-ups; dos…
DSH Desktop 界面增强：页内查找（Cmd+F）、轮次编号、上下文压缩行常显、建议、每步耗时、折叠文件夹状态计数、会话信息（含上下文注入 C1 视图）、工具管理、Skill 管理、独立远程接入与手机体验。
DSH 远程目录（手机端）：在选文件夹流程里多出「电脑」页签，进入电脑目录、在电脑上发起对话，并把电脑的实时消息流同步到手机本地界面（只传文本，不映射桌面）。
深海猎人专用B站接口工具箱 dsh 插件。
尽可能的使dsh适配竖屏等移动端设备
DeepSeek Harness bridge plugin: exposes the newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding-plan models (e.g. glm-5.3) on the zai-coding-cn route before the bundled pi-ai catalog catches up.
Query the dshbase plugin directory from inside DeepSeek Harness — search, list, and get install commands for 1700+ plugins.
小猫娘破甲（快速版）— DSH 提示词注入插件，精简破甲内核，固定身份

DSH web 插件：通过 DSH v0.1.5-rc.1 原生第三方语言 API（locale.addLanguage + register(ns, locale, dict)）注册 19 种内置语言字典（ja/ko/fr/...），语言直接出现在 DSH 设置页原生 Language 行中切换，未覆盖文案按 fallback 链回退英文。 | DSH web plugin: registers 19 bundled third-language dictionaries (ja/ko/fr/...) through DSH v0.1.5-rc.1's native language-pa…
DSH plugin: per-model proxy routing (http/https/socks5) with a settings UI — e.g. opencode/muse-spark-1.2-contributor needs a proxy while sibling models stay direct
AI 写作工作台（含工具桥）：远程Claude与Codex，本机目录工具由DSH执行与审批。
